question: Which of the following rivers is NOT related to the coastal plain of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Brahmaputra**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Brahmaputra River is not related to the coastal plain of India because**:

 
 
• it** flows through the northeastern part of India**, primarily in the state of Assam.
 
• This **region is located in the Himalayan foothills** and is not part of the coastal plain.
 
• **The river originates in Tibet,** flows through Arunachal Pradesh, and then enters Assam.
 
• Its **course is primarily eastward, parallel to the Himalayas**, and it does not flow towards the coast.
 
• The Brahmaputra's drainage basin is primarily in the northeastern part of India and parts of Bangladesh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fa7e20f3cc0b01b842d66e51759888337c54004976f7f8bad4dbf7be109515a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna River**:

 
 
• The **Krishna River originates in the Western Ghats** and flows eastward through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **It forms a fertile delta at its mouth, known as the Krishna Delta, which is an important agricultural region.**
 
 
 
• **Mahanadi River**:
 
 
• The **Mahanadi River originates in the Western Ghats and flows eastward through the states of Chhattisgarh and Odisha.**
 
• It also forms a fertile delta at its mouth, known as the Mahanadi Delta, which is an important agricultural region.
 
 
 
• ** Kaveri River**:
 
 
• The** Kaveri River originates in the Western Ghats and flows southward through the states of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• ** It forms a fertile delta at its mouth, known as the Kaveri Delta,** which is an important agricultural region.
